event_summary: A lit figurine on a round base changes orientation while its large shadow on the wall changes shape.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a bright white figurine centered on a dark round base on a tabletop, with a large dark shadow cast on the wall inside a circular light area. Over time, the figurine’s visible side changes from a front-facing view toward a side view and then toward a rear view, while the wall shadow shifts and changes outline correspondingly. The camera view remains fixed.

reasons: The figurine, base, tabletop, wall, bright light area, and shadow are visible in the first frame.
The first frame already shows the lit object and its shadow, indicating an ongoing visual process rather than a separate onset.

objects.name: figurine
objects.visible_form: Small pale seated or kneeling human-like decorative figure with draped clothing or hair-like contours.
objects.material_description: Light-colored, glossy or reflective surface with bright highlights and overexposed areas.
objects.initial_motion_description: At the start, the figurine is centered and already appears in a changing orientation sequence.
objects.initial_integrity_description: The figurine appears intact with no visible breakage or separation.
event_role_hints: Its visible orientation changes over time.
Its outline corresponds to the changing shadow on the wall.

objects.name: round base
objects.visible_form: Dark circular platform beneath the figurine.
objects.material_description: Dark, smooth-looking surface with bright reflections near the front.
objects.initial_motion_description: The base remains centered in the frame; no separate base motion is clearly distinguishable from the figurine orientation change.
event_role_hints: The figurine sits on top of it.

objects.name: light source
objects.visible_form: Bright small light at or near the front of the base, shining upward and backward.
objects.material_description: Very bright white light with glare and overexposed glow.
objects.initial_integrity_description: The light remains visibly active throughout.
event_role_hints: A circular illuminated area is visible on the wall behind the figurine.

objects.name: wall
objects.visible_form: Flat vertical background surface behind the tabletop.
event_role_hints: The shadow and circular light area appear on it.

objects.name: shadow
objects.visible_form: Large dark silhouette on the wall behind the figurine, with an outline changing from broad and symmetrical to side-profile-like and then broad again.
objects.material_description: Dark region within the illuminated wall area.
objects.initial_motion_description: The shadow begins as a large centered dark silhouette on the wall.
objects.initial_integrity_description: The shadow is continuous and not fragmented.
event_role_hints: Its shape changes as the figurine orientation changes.

objects.name: tabletop
objects.visible_form: Horizontal wooden surface beneath the base.
objects.material_description: Wood-toned surface with visible grain-like texture.

objects.name: cable
objects.visible_form: Dark cord extending from the base area toward the right side of the frame.
event_role_hints: It is connected near the base area.

initial_relation_observations.relation_description: The figurine is positioned on top of the round base.
The round base is on the tabletop.
The shadow is visible on the wall behind the figurine.
The bright light is located near the front of the base.
The cable extends from near the base toward the right side of the tabletop.

evidence_bank.observation: A pale figurine is centered on a dark round base.
The dark round base rests on a wooden tabletop.
A large dark silhouette appears on the wall behind the figurine.
A bright white light is visible at the front lower area of the figurine and base.
A dark cable runs from the base area toward the right side of the frame.
The wall contains a circular illuminated area surrounding the shadow.
The figurine initially shows a mostly front-facing view with symmetrical draped shapes.
The figurine later shows a side-facing profile with the head and body viewed from one side.
The wall shadow narrows and becomes more side-profile-like during the middle portion.
The figurine later shows a rear-facing view with long vertical draped contours down the back.
The wall shadow becomes broad and centered again during the late portion.
The camera framing remains fixed with the base near the bottom center and the wall shadow above it.

observations: The figurine is centered in front of the wall.
A large shadow is already present on the wall.

object_events.observation: The figurine presents a mostly front-facing view.
The shadow appears large, dark, and centered within the circular light area.

observations: The visible orientation of the figurine changes progressively.
The shadow outline changes at the same time.

object_events.observation: The figurine changes from a front-facing view toward a side-facing profile.
The shadow changes into a narrower side-profile-like outline.

observations: The visible orientation of the figurine continues changing.
The shadow remains on the wall and continues changing outline.

object_events.observation: The figurine presents a rear-facing view with long draped contours visible.
The shadow becomes broad and centered again.

unresolved_observations: The bright light overexposes parts of the figurine, obscuring some fine surface details.
The exact motion of the base is not separately distinguishable from the figurine’s changing orientation.
